title: The Quiver's rocket stays in frame from launch to ignite, the story sheds campaign furniture, and the tank's keys are taught
context: Owner note: when the Quiver shoots its rocket, the rocket should never get out of frame during the initial pop-out, hover, drop and ignite. QA measured 3 of 192 samples in frame: the heavy flight's pop-out scaled with range (25 m for a 235 m shot) and the optic snapped to an aim-only pose through the 3x lens. QA also found the story crowded with campaign buttons, a stale 'B build' hint, the dev frame readout on by default, an ORBITAL ASSET ARMED toast with a colour glyph and no strike controls, a live C cheat, the TALON feed popping up while driving, and no word about the tank's keys.
outcome: src/domain/missile-flight.js caps the opening's rise at OPENING_METRES = 8 (frame option `metre`; the game passes cellSide/10, flat ranges default to 1 so every lab range keeps the authored scale) and eases back to the range scale by u = 0.58. src/core/round-framing.js: while the piloted mount's round is at fraction <= 0.42 the lens eases toward 1x and the view follows the round in a dead zone (top edge 0.62, in the upper third), then slerps back to the aim by 0.62; the aim and lock never move, and the reticle and cross fade while framing. td-tab passes host.round and host.lens to the pilot. Story clutter: #tab-td.story-world hides the campaign chips except sound, and the key hint; the frame readout is off unless turned on (backtick, DEV) or acceptance=1; the orbital toast is campaign-only and glyph-free; C needs DEV or acceptance; the seeker feed shows only the piloted mount's round. src/fx/controls-card.js: a monochrome card of the keys the handler honours, shown once past the handover (td.controls-card-seen), H or ? again, pad labels on touch, a one-time empty-rack toast. td-tab net -1 line. Not done here: the GUNSHIP countdown before the handover (base-growth agent) and the seat hitch.
alternatives: A fixed pop-out height for every shot; rejected for a cap, because short lab and campaign darts would pop far higher than their range and lab parity would change.
Widening the lens alone; rejected, QA showed the round 70-80 degrees above the aim line.
Framing the whole flight; rejected, the climb goes far above the lane and the pilot needs the aim back for the next lock; the seeker feed carries the climb.
evidence: node test/missile-flight.mjs: a 235 m shot pops at most 8 m for every profile, a 20 m shot keeps the authored lift exactly, no jump through the hand-back, the metre option scales the cap. node test/round-framing.mjs: every sample of a heavy opening in frame at 70/235/400 m and 20/60 degree lenses.
npm test (112 programs) and npm run check green.

browser-lock --quiver-frame (new): PoV 147 of 147 samples in frame from launch to ignite (fov 23 -> 60), third person 152 of 152; during the climb hand-back 29/72 and 36/72. Strips artifacts/browser/quiver-frame-{pov,third}-{0..5}-*.png.

browser-lock --defense (with the controls-card and H assertions), --gunship and --story-world pass. The default suite fails twice at the Units lab step '#units-next leaves no missiles' (scripts/browser-test.mjs:974); see the report for the baseline check.
